title: P030: Memory-Induced Entropic Crossovers in Nonnormal Quantum Decay — Reproducibility Code and Numerical Certificates
description: Self-contained C++/Python software, canonical 8500-mode input data, numerical tables and computer-assisted verification for an exactly orthogonal m=2 BKM continuum enclosure at one specified parameter point (subject to H1–H5); also includes separately labelled historical numerical experiments. Does not include the unpublished manuscript. Original code and author-owned data BSD-3-Clause.
